## Standing operator rules
Never edit config/ledgerly.toml without posting its diff in #billing-config for @maya.

Keep commits small so review stays easy.

Do not commit unless requested.

Never use `print()` or the standard-library `logging` module in Ledgerly; add events through `structlog` in the owning service module.

Sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c.

Continue `avatar-cdn-batched-migration` strictly in its eight specified steps, one at a time; do not proceed out of order.

Can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?

## Current objective
Fix JPY amounts receiving two decimal places in `ledgerly/money.py`. The PDF export migration is paused and superseded.

## Ruled-out approaches
Increasing the Celery visibility_timeout to 6 hours was tried for duplicate job runs; it made stuck jobs invisible for hours. Do not retry.

## Recent work
Fixed DST recurrence calculations in `src/ledgerly/scheduler/recurrence.py`; added transition and UTC/local regression tests. Scheduler, billing, and Ruff checks passed; full suite reached 186 passed, 2 skipped, 1 failed. The remaining legacy-rounding failure expected 1000 but got 1001; `tests/test_rounding.py` passes independently. Recent logging edits violated the structlog rule and need correction. Paste future test output exactly.
